pages.text: Takes the position of an energy-accepting block and the amount of energy to insert. Returns the position if successful, or null if the target refuses your generous electrical donation.$(br2)Energy is measured in Forge Energy units (FE). Most machines accept reasonable amounts, but don't try to power a toaster with the energy output of a small star.$(br2)$(bold)Media Cost:$() 1 dust per 5,000 FE transferred. Converting magic into electricity ain't free!

pages.title: Mishaps & Warnings
pages.text: $(li)Targeting empty air will result in disappointment and wasted media$(li)Negative energy amounts are rejected - machines cannot run on spite$(li)Some blocks simply don't understand the concept of energy$(li)Side effects may include: spontaneous automation, confused engineers, and machines that hum suspiciously$(br2)Remember: with great power comes great electricity bills.
